# Security Policy

If you discover a security vulnerability within RepoExe, please report it via GitHub Security Advisories.

## Reporting a Bug or Security Vulnerability

The preferred way to report security vulnerabilities is through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/SjnExe/RepoExe/security). This allows us to collaborate on a fix while maintaining confidentiality of the report.

1. Visit the [Security tab](https://github.com/SjnExe/RepoExe/security)
2. Click Report a vulnerability and follow the provided steps.
